provinces.name: Aurenhal Capital District
provinces.desc: The country round the capital: its suburbs, commuter towns and farmland. The city itself is a province of its own.

provinces.name: Northern Dales
provinces.desc: Upland farming country around Halveth and the upper Halve.

provinces.name: Lumiria
provinces.desc: The north-west. Once the elven kingdom of Lumiria, conquered in 1513 when its capital Etharion fell.

provinces.name: Westmarch
provinces.desc: Border province along Brennland, between the Lumiria Highlands and the coast.

provinces.name: Corvenne
provinces.desc: The coast province around the port of Corvenne.

provinces.name: Lower Halve
provinces.desc: The lower Halve valley around Merrowgate.

provinces.name: Kestmark
provinces.desc: Mountain province around the Kesten range. Formerly the kingdom of Kestmark, united with the Estelorian crown in 1447.

provinces.name: Eastern Province
provinces.desc: The east, around Ostrey and the Ireyn valley, on the Varsenne border.

provinces.name: Ardmere
provinces.desc: South-eastern province on the Mirova border. Formerly the duchy of Ardmere, annexed in 1497.

provinces.name: Duncarrow
provinces.desc: Southern province around the garrison town of Duncarrow.

provinces.name: Southern Reach
provinces.desc: Dry southern hill country along the Alcora border.

provinces.name: Midmarch
provinces.desc: Farmland between the capital and the Kesten foothills.

provinces.name: City of Aurenhal
provinces.desc: The capital within its city limits, governed as a province of its own.

places.d: Capital of Esteloria, on the river Auren. Seat of the Provisional Council since 10 January 2024.
Esteloria's only seaport, at the mouth of the Halve on the Gulf of Corvenne. Shipping, shipbuilding and heavy industry.
River-trade city on the Halve below its meeting with the Auren. Quays, warehouses and the Mill Weir crossing to the south.
Railway town and market centre of the Northern Dales, on the upper Halve. Northern Command was based here until 2024.
Principal city of the Eastern Province, below the Ostrey Uplands.
Garrison town in the south, home of the state gaol and of a large military reservation.
Dales town at the junction of the northern main line and the closed Blackmere branch.
Moorland hamlet at the end of the closed branch line north of Stenhollow, beside the Black Mere. Site of the former state sanatorium.
County town of Ireyn, a small rural county in the east on the Ireyn river.

sites.name: TPF Headquarters (Kingsgate Annex)
sites.status: Taken by Vaelthorn on 21.10.2023 (ASHFALL); held by the Provisional Council
sites.desc: The building on Kingsgate Avenue that never displayed a name plate. Director's Office, records vault (B1), signals centre (B2), plant room and demolition control (B3). Officially a Ministry of the Interior annex.

sites.name: TPF Primary Records Facility
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024. Source of the public archive releases.
sites.desc: Central archive of the Division. Held the Flame's files back to the 17th century. Seat of the 2008 disciplinary tribunal.

sites.name: TPF Cyber Division
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: Signals and network security. First used the name "Vaelthorn" in a TPF document (14.09.2013).

sites.name: Eastern Research Laboratory
sites.status: Decommissioned 2013. Its archive was taken from the transport at the Route 9 river bridge, 14.11.2013
sites.desc: Detention and testing site in the forest north of the Ireyn river. Held Subjects 36 and 37 from 2008 until their escape on 25–26.03.2013. Supplied Site 41 with donor material.

sites.name: Site 41 (Blackmere)
sites.status: Entered by Vaelthorn 23–24.10.2023 (LYCHGATE II). Building left standing
sites.desc: The former state sanatorium at Blackmere, converted for the embryonic-modification protocol. On no map made after 1988. Reached only by the closed branch line from Stenhollow.

sites.name: Northern Transit Depot
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: Ministry platform at the depot end of the Halveth freight yard, with a holding block and cold store. Quarterly transfers to S41 left from here. Site of the Halveth rail yard killings, 12.12.2022.

sites.name: Northern Command Barracks
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: Headquarters of TPF Northern Command (Col. G. Brandt).

sites.name: TPF Holding Block, Tanners' Row
sites.status: Closed after FIRESTEP, 02.08.2015
sites.desc: Three-storey former warehouse used to hold detainees awaiting transfer to Aurenhal.

sites.name: Merrowgate River Barracks
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: TPF garrison on the Merrowgate waterfront.

sites.name: Duncarrow Garrison
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: Largest TPF garrison in the south, with a mortar section covering the approach road.

sites.name: Old Commandery of the Purifying Flame
sites.status: Ruin. Listed historic site
sites.desc: The Flame's northern commandery. Its 1688 proclamation offered bounties on harbourers and first recorded the three-thorn mark.

sites.name: Corvenne Port Intake Station
sites.status: Emptied in ASHGROVE, 2021: the new arrivals were taken off the manifests before they were processed. Never reopened
sites.desc: Customs-shed annex on the docks where people taken at the port were held before transfer inland.

sites.name: Ostrey Field Station
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: Base for collection units working the Eastern Province and the Varsenne border.

sites.name: Field Collection Unit 7 Base
sites.status: Raided in GABION, 2017; its records carried off
sites.desc: Home of the unit that searched the forest north of the Ireyn river in 2008.

sites.name: Southern Transit Depot
sites.status: Its fuel depot burned in DEFILADE, 2019; the depot was not used again
sites.desc: Rail transfer point for detainees moved through the south.

sites.name: Westmarch Detention Centre
sites.status: Its detention block cleared by Vaelthorn in MARROW, 2016
sites.desc: Regional holding centre for the west.

sites.name: Lumiria Field Station
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: One of the Division's oldest field stations, in the former elven kingdom.

sites.name: Kestmark Signal Station
sites.status: Its sentry guns blinded and the station taken in PALISADE, 2019
sites.desc: Mountain radio relay on the Division's eastern network.

sites.name: Ardmere Holding Facility
sites.status: Taken in WOODWIGHT, 2021, its garrison locked inside its own barracks
sites.desc: Holding facility near the Mirova border.

sites.name: Midmarch Records Annex
sites.status: Its server block breached and burned in DRYFALL, 2016
sites.desc: Overflow records store for the primary facility in Aurenhal.

sites.name: Southern Reach Field Station
sites.status: Overrun with its border checkpoint in CHEVAL, 2021
sites.desc: Field station for the southern hill country and the Alcora border.

sites.name: Dales Training Ground
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: Moorland training area used by northern field units.

sites.name: Lower Halve Detention Centre
sites.status: Its searchlights blacked out in a storm and its block opened in HAYWIRE, 2016
sites.desc: Holding centre south of Merrowgate.

sites.name: Corvenne Coast Field Station
sites.status: Breached through its intake in GREYWATER, 2015
sites.desc: Watched the coast and the fishing harbours.

sites.name: Eastern Detention Centre
sites.status: Stormed through its main gate in SALLYPORT, 2018; its detainees freed
sites.desc: Regional holding centre for the east.

sites.name: Duncarrow Training Depot
sites.status: Its ammunition store burned out in EMBERWELL, 2022
sites.desc: Training depot for field units drawn from the garrison.

sites.name: Route 9 Bridge
sites.desc: Road bridge over the Ireyn river. Explosions and gunfire were reported here on 14.11.2013; the government called it a chemical storage accident.

sites.name: Mill Weir
sites.desc: Weir and crossing on the Halve south of Merrowgate.

sites.name: Halveth Freight Yard
sites.desc: Freight sidings with one Ministry platform at the depot end, crossed by the Halve footbridge.

sites.name: St. Brannoc's Hall
sites.desc: Church hall at the top of the hill past the co-op. Used as a rest centre in December 2022.

sites.name: Ireyn Valley Regional Hospital
sites.desc: County hospital. Took at least eleven admissions on the night of the Route 9 bridge incident, 13–14.11.2013.

sites.name: St. Aldric's Children's Home (former)
sites.desc: Harbour Street. A children's home for a hundred years, closed in 1989.

sites.name: National Broadcasting House
sites.desc: National television and radio centre. The 9 January 2024 broadcast was made from here.

sites.name: Memorial to the Victims of the Purifying Flame
sites.desc: Memorial wall raised under Decree No. 1, Article VII, unveiled in 2024. Names where they are known; numbers where only a number was kept.

sites.name: Duncarrow Gaol
sites.desc: State prison and former garrison gaol.

sites.name: Etharion (ruins)
sites.desc: Remains of the capital of the elven kingdom of Lumiria, which fell to the Purifying Flame in August 1513.

sites.name: Ireyn Border Crossing
sites.desc: Official crossing into Varsenne.

sites.name: Wencombe Relay Station
sites.status: Taken in STILLWATER, 2023, its own recognition grid turned against its officers
sites.desc: Radio relay on the capital's western ring, linking Kingsgate with the northern barracks.

sites.name: Redholt Holding Block
sites.status: Its guards left the night TPF headquarters fell (21.10.2023); the detainees were let out the next morning
sites.desc: Converted bonded warehouse used to hold people taken in the capital before questioning at Kingsgate.

sites.name: Thurlmore Records Annex
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: Card-index store for the capital's informant files.

sites.name: Bramore Detention Centre
sites.status: Emptied in GLACIS, 2018; the children held there were carried out under fire
sites.desc: Regional holding centre for the Corvenne hinterland.

sites.name: Todcliffe Coast Watch
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: Radar and radio post watching the coast road and the fishing harbours.

sites.name: Bramwell Field Station
sites.status: Its wire torn down and its courtyard taken in ABATIS, 2017
sites.desc: Base for collection units working the lower Halve valley.

sites.name: Dewmoor Holding Facility
sites.status: Its east wing burned in CINDERGATE, 2016; closed
sites.desc: Two-storey holding facility on the Dewmoor road.

sites.name: Harwood Barracks
sites.status: Destroyed in OSSUARY, 2018
sites.desc: Barracks of the second battalion of Northern Command.

sites.name: Fenwick Records Office
sites.status: Its data vault emptied in THRESHER, 2018
sites.desc: District records office for the northern dales.

sites.name: Branmore Transit Yard
sites.status: Closed in December 2022, when the transfers to the north stopped
sites.desc: Rail siding and sheds where transfers north of Halveth were made up.

sites.name: Thorpfield Holding Block
sites.status: Opened at night in THISTLEDOWN, 2016; its detainees freed
sites.desc: Holding block behind the Thorpfield police station.

sites.name: Loftham Signal Post
sites.status: Its electrified gate shorted and the post taken in POSTERN, 2015
sites.desc: Relay on the eastern network between Ostrey and the Varsenne border.

sites.name: Ebbley Records Annex
sites.status: Its servers emptied in COLDROOM, 2014
sites.desc: Records store for the southern command.

sites.name: Aldby Field Station
sites.status: Its bunkers reduced in REVETMENT, 2020
sites.desc: Base for field units covering the southern farmland.

sites.name: Selton Holding Centre
sites.status: Its containment block breached in BRACKWATER, 2019
sites.desc: Holding centre in the old customs depot by the Selton goods yard.

sites.name: Breybury Barracks
sites.status: Taken in KESTREL, 2017, its garrison cut off from any help
sites.desc: Garrison for the western command.

sites.name: Rookstead Training Range
sites.status: Dissolved by Provisional Council Decree No. 1, 10.01.2024
sites.desc: Firing range and training ground on the Rookstead moor.

sites.name: Ravenford Border Post
sites.status: Its gatehouse taken in SORTIE, 2020
sites.desc: Watched the crossings on the Mirova border.

sites.name: Coldgate Signal Station
sites.status: Taken from the cliff side in ESCARP, 2019
sites.desc: Hilltop relay on the south-eastern network.

sites.name: Derrton Heath Detention Centre
sites.status: Its detainees got out in TALLOW, 2022
sites.desc: Holding centre for Midmarch, between the capital and the foothills.

sites.name: Fengate Transit Depot
sites.status: Its lockdown broken in COLDIRON, 2020
sites.desc: Transfer point on the line from Picklow to the capital.

sites.name: Asham Records Room
sites.status: Its registry taken off a burning terminal in BRIARFALL, 2018
sites.desc: Records of the Division's work in the former elven kingdom.

sites.name: Langhurst Holding Facility
sites.status: Emptied in a midnight recovery, FALLOW, 2018
sites.desc: Holding facility for the southern hill country.

sites.name: Cadby Barracks
sites.status: Burned out in SCORCH, 2019
sites.desc: Barracks guarding the Alcora border road.

sites.name: Moskmoor Mountain Station
sites.status: Emptied in HOARFROST, 2023; its detainees taken out over the passes
sites.desc: Field station for the Kesten mountain passes.
